title: VPN connection drops for remote users
description: Remote staff lose VPN access every few minutes during work hours.
resolution: Adjust VPN keepalive settings and verify gateway stability

title: Application login page returns 500
description: Users receive a server error when signing into the portal.
resolution: Restart the app service and check the authentication backend

title: Suspicious MFA prompts detected
description: Multiple users report unexpected MFA prompts after failed login attempts.
resolution: Block suspicious IPs and review conditional access policies

title: Database backup job failed overnight
description: The nightly database backup could not reach the target mount.
resolution: Restore the storage mount and rerun the backup job

title: Shared storage volume nearly full
description: New uploads fail because the file share is above capacity.
resolution: Archive stale data and expand the storage volume

title: New employee cannot access payroll system
description: Access request is pending and the user cannot open the payroll portal.
resolution: Approve the role-based access package and sync group membership

title: Server CPU spikes after patch deployment
description: Production servers are hitting sustained high CPU usage after the latest patch rollout.
resolution: Rollback the patch on affected nodes and reschedule after capacity review

title: Email service delays during peak hours
description: Users report delayed email delivery and intermittent mailbox sync issues.
resolution: Restart the mail connector and increase processing capacity

title: Firewall rule blocks approved vendor traffic
description: A vendor application is unable to connect due to a newly added firewall rule.
resolution: Review the rule change and add an approved exception if needed

title: Database replication lag increasing
description: The read replica is lagging behind the primary by several minutes during peak load.
resolution: Rebalance long-running queries and increase replica throughput

title: Shared drive permissions missing for finance team
description: Finance users cannot open a shared folder after a group update.
resolution: Restore the finance group permissions and validate access

title: Storage array latency above threshold
description: File operations are slow and storage monitoring shows elevated latency.
resolution: Check disk health and rebalance workloads across the array

title: Core switch port flapping
description: Network monitoring shows a switch port repeatedly going up and down.
resolution: Replace the cable and verify switch port stability

title: Application search results are incomplete
description: Users report missing records when searching the internal portal.
resolution: Rebuild the search index and validate query permissions

title: Unauthorized access alert on admin account
description: The SIEM triggered an alert for a suspicious admin login from a foreign IP.
resolution: Disable the session

title: Database query timing out on report export
description: Large report exports time out before completion.
resolution: Optimize the query and schedule the export during off-peak hours

title: Backup storage target unavailable
description: The backup application cannot write to the target repository.
resolution: Restore the repository connection and retry the backup job

title: Office Wi-Fi disconnects intermittently
description: Users in the east wing lose Wi-Fi connectivity several times per day.
resolution: Check access point interference and update firmware

title: Password reset requests are not syncing
description: Users cannot complete password resets after the identity platform update.
resolution: Verify directory sync and restart the identity connector

title: Application deployment fails in staging
description: The release pipeline fails during the deploy step with a package validation error.
resolution: Fix the package artifact and rerun the deployment pipeline
